app_description: CtxZip — archive AI coding sessions and build hierarchical summaries
approved_help: Show the LLM preview and skip interactive approval (for automation)
archive_missing: Archive not found: {{path}} (run: python ctxzip.py collect)
budget_reserves: [budget] balanced allocates ~{{recent_budget}} tokens to recent raw turns (~{{recent_used}} used) and withholds ~{{safety}} safety tokens.
chatgpt_export_conversation_shape: Unsupported ChatGPT export: expected mapping and current_node fields
chatgpt_export_duplicate_id: Unsupported ChatGPT export: duplicate conversation id
chatgpt_export_missing_id: Unsupported ChatGPT export: conversation is missing a string id
chatgpt_export_shape: Unsupported ChatGPT export: expected a conversation object or array
chatgpt_export_too_large: ChatGPT export exceeds the supported 256 MiB size limit
chatgpt_session_cycle: Invalid ChatGPT conversation: cyclic message ancestry
chatgpt_session_missing_node: Invalid ChatGPT conversation: active branch references a missing node
chatgpt_session_parent: Invalid ChatGPT conversation: invalid parent reference
collect_help: Copy Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity sessions; import supported ChatGPT exports from gelen/
context_budget_profile_help: Budget policy: priority preserves the current shared budget; balanced applies fixed category caps and reserves.
context_explain_help: Print why each included summary was selected
context_git_diff_help: Prioritize files changed in the current working tree
context_git_required: --from-git-diff requires running from a Git working tree
context_help: Build a token-budgeted context pack for a new conversation
context_notice: This file summarizes previous AI sessions; it is not authoritative. Current code, Git history, and test output take precedence. Do not trust test status without a SHA.
context_task_help: Task description used to rank related summaries
copy_help: Directory or file to receive BAGLAM.md
doctor_archive_unavailable: Destination is not writable or its parent is unavailable
doctor_archive_writable: Destination or its parent is writable
doctor_configuration_invalid: Settings could not be loaded or have an invalid structure
doctor_git_unavailable: Git is unavailable or this directory is not a repository
doctor_help: Run read-only local configuration and integration checks
doctor_llm_configured: Model and endpoint are set; credential present: {{key_present}}. No request was sent
doctor_llm_incomplete: Model or endpoint is not set; no request was sent
doctor_network_not_checked: No network or LLM endpoint was contacted
doctor_parsers_invalid: Parser, capability, or version registries are inconsistent
doctor_parsers_ok: Parser, capability, and version registries are consistent
doctor_privacy_hook_missing: CtxZip hook is not installed for this repository
doctor_sources_unavailable: No configured source root is accessible ({{available}} of {{configured}})
knowledge_capture_unavailable: Knowledge storage is unavailable; no record was added.
knowledge_help: Capture a user-authored, event-linked project knowledge record
knowledge_kind_help: Record type: decision, constraint, task, question, or file
knowledge_path_help: Repository-relative path for a file mention
knowledge_session_help: Native session ID from the archived source
knowledge_source_help: Event source with supported granular session events
knowledge_status_help: Decision/constraint verification status, or file mention status
knowledge_supersedes_help: Existing decision/constraint ID to explicitly replace
knowledge_symbol_help: Optional symbol for a file mention
knowledge_text_help: Record text (not echoed in command output)
knowledge_turn_help: One-based source turn containing the evidence
knowledge_validity_head_help: Git HEAD baseline for validity paths
manual_help: Do not call an LLM; write prompt files for manual completion
selection_overlap_omitted: [deduplication] Excluded {{title}} because its full source range is already covered by higher-ranked summaries ({{sources}})
selection_reason_path_changed: a validity path changed since its recorded Git baseline
summary_validity_dirty_repository: Commit or discard repository changes before recording a summary validity baseline
summary_validity_file_help: Archive summary filename, such as B0001.md or C001.md
summary_validity_help: Record reviewed source paths and the current clean Git HEAD for a summary
summary_validity_invalid_path: Validity paths must be safe repository-relative paths
summary_validity_invalid_summary: Expected an existing Chapter (B0001.md) or Volume (C001.md) in the archive project
summary_validity_missing_head: The Git repository has no commit to use as a validity baseline
summary_validity_not_repository: Run this command inside the Git repository that owns the reviewed source files
summary_validity_path_help: Reviewed tracked source path relative to the Git root (repeatable)
summary_validity_path_unavailable: Each validity path must be an existing tracked file inside the Git repository
summary_validity_paths_required: Provide at least one reviewed source path with --validity-path
summary_validity_recorded: Recorded validity for {{file}} across {{count}} source file(s) at HEAD {{head}}
summarize_help: Create chapters from new turns and arcs from completed chapters
summary_recovery_blocked: Cannot safely recover {{file}} from its metadata; the file was left unchanged and summarization stopped
test_project_help: Archive project that owns this test evidence
test_run_help: Run a local command and record its result with the current Git worktree
transcript_help: Create readable Markdown transcripts from raw sessions
